name: agent-watch
description: A themeable Windows home for your local coding agents.
author: William Pyle

scripts.build: npm run themes:check && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Restore world customization and the woodland atmosphere.

- Edit world: place and drag scenery, paint terrain, resize and mirror objects, duplicate or remove, undo/redo, save or cancel.
- Place character homes and activity destinations visually.
- Layouts are stored outside downloaded themes, survive theme updates, and retain a previous-save recovery copy.
- Mooseville 1.1.0 restores flowing water, rising chimney smoke and correctly aligned bridges. Effects follow moved and mirrored buildings and respect reduced motion.
- Existing installations discover this release through Settings & updates or at startup.

Download Agent-Watch-Setup-0.2.1-x64.exe below. Builds remain unsigned.

Validation: 28 unit tests, desktop editor gestures, saved-layout relaunch, ambient animation pixel checks, packaged-app tests, original artwork/map hash checks, and a real GitHub Mooseville upgrade preserving a saved layout.
